title: Musk Discloses 48.4% SpaceX Stake Worth Over $900B Ahead of Aug 20 Unlock
detail: A regulatory filing published August 13, 2026 showed Elon Musk held a 48.4% economic stake in SpaceX as of June 30 — 6.42 billion shares worth more than $900 billion at current prices — while retaining over 82% of voting power through Class B shares since the IPO. Musk noted that a large portion of the stake 'only vests on extremely crazy good outcomes for SpaceX,' so the fully-vested percentage is lower. SPCX shares extended their rally, rising as much as 9.65% intraday to $146.15 and pushing the four-day gain above 40%, as investors looked past the disclosure toward the next scheduled unlock on August 20, when roughly 320 million additional shares (about $42.5 billion) become eligible for sale.

media.caption: Elon Musk's 48.4% SpaceX stake is disclosed as worth more than $900 billion, August 13, 2026

title: SpaceX Backs Down, Keeps Poland in European Starlink Roam Zone
detail: SpaceX confirmed on August 13, 2026 that Poland will remain in the common European Starlink Roam roaming zone — covering more than 30 countries including Germany, France, Italy, and Ukraine's neighbors — reversing an earlier decision to remove it. Polish Digital Affairs Minister Krzysztof Gawkowski said 'SpaceX has responded to my request and will not treat Polish customers worse than those in other European countries,' and Starlink's website listed Poland among the included countries as of August 13. The reversal followed pressure from Polish officials, including Foreign Minister Radosław Sikorski, who had threatened to review Poland's roughly $50 million a year in Starlink spending on terminals supplied to Ukraine.

media.caption: SpaceX confirms Poland will stay in the European Starlink Roam zone, August 13, 2026
